sheets.name: State Requirements Tracker
sheets.notes: One row per state where you sell or plan to sell. Verify your state rules locally before producing or selling. Caps and registration rules change often. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD so expiration formulas sort correctly. Column K shows days between expiration and last verification as a simple date difference for planning only.

sheets.name: Label Compliance Checker
sheets.notes: Use one row per product and label version. Y means present and legible on the actual printed label. N means missing or unclear. Result column uses a formula so the sheet flags HOLD automatically. L2 counts total HOLD rows needing fixes. This sheet supports careful review; it does not confer legal approval. Verify your state rules locally. This material is not legal advice.

sheets.name: Registration Log
sheets.notes: Log every filing, training certificate, and renewal. Days To Renewal uses Renewal Due minus today. Negative means overdue. K2 sums fees paid for simple budgeting. Keep paper or PDF copies filed by confirmation number.

sheets.name: Sales Cap Tracker
sheets.notes: Enter one row per month per state. Net Monthly Sales subtracts refunds. Running Year Total is a cumulative sum. Remaining Under Cap subtracts the running total from the annual cap. Percent Of Cap Used divides running total by cap for planning only. Figures here are illustrative examples. Verify your state rules locally for how your state defines gross vs net sales and which channels count toward the cap.
